evidenceBoundary: Every design score below comes from the 106 LongMemEval-V2 procedure questions already consumed by D9-D11. No static-environment development, validation, or test score was read before this decision.

iterations.policy: first same-trajectory external candidate; exact Base on ineligibility
iterations.finding: No first external candidate added an answer atom; reject.

iterations.policy: skip evidence-equivalent candidates; exact Base on ineligibility
iterations.finding: Higher use did not isolate an external-evidence gain and could discard D11 gains; reject composition.

iterations.policy: first novel candidate; inherit D11 on ordinary ineligibility
iterations.finding: Zero direct change versus D11; retain only as the selection ablation.

iterations.policy: select one bounded same-trajectory candidate with maximum novel semantic-span count; then fewer novel characters and earlier retrieval rank
iterations.finding: Selected candidate: +0.6410 percentage points versus D11, one improved and zero harmed direct cases; +5.3419 points versus Base, four improved and zero harmed; mean tokens -18.9427% versus Base and +4.3704% versus D11. This is only a design signal, not confirmation.

selectedPolicy.selectionRule: Reproduce D11, inspect at most the existing Base Top-40 raw candidates from the selected trajectory, exclude exact Base items and semantic duplicates, then choose one bounded candidate by descending novel semantic-span count, ascending novel characters, ascending FTS rank, and stable id.
selectedPolicy.ordinaryNoop: If D11 is ineligible, return Base. If external evidence is absent, redundant, over bounds, or cannot fit the remaining Base budget, retain the exact D11 context.
selectedPolicy.hardFallback: Disabled, timeout, missing index or candidate pool, corrupt structure, or impossible certificate failure returns exact Base.
